units.rawText: Professor, if possible... I'd like you to witness that day with me. Without your help and guidance, we would never have had such a possibility.

units.rawText: "Don't enter the loop of slaughter again..." Those were her last words. She hoped I would never reset her, because she had already fulfilled our dream.

units.rawText: But when I came to the Oasis and began rebuilding Cyclopes, I had a new thought... Our dream absolutely doesn't stop at cutting the loop of slaughter.

units.rawText: Professor, I'll keep fighting. For our tomorrow, for our dream, I'll keep fighting. I believe that when true peace finally comes... that will be the view Tasha wanted to see.
